title: Pieces left hanging
line: Before every move: checks, captures, threats, and is anything of yours or theirs undefended.

steps.text: A piece is hanging when it can be captured and nothing guards it. Black has just attacked your queen with the knight.
Before you save the queen, look at what Black left behind. Capture the hanging pawn, with check.

wrong.h5f7: That is check, but nothing guards the queen on f7: the king takes her.

steps.hint: Look for the black pawn that nothing guards.
steps.after: The queen is safe, the pawn is yours, and Black must answer the check.

steps.text: Now look at your own pieces. Black's knight has just come to a5.
Tap the white piece that is attacked and has no guard.

wrong.d5: The pawn on d5 is attacked, but your bishop guards it.
wrong.g5: Nothing attacks the knight on g5 right now.

steps.after: The knight on a5 attacks the bishop, and no white piece guards it.

steps.hint: A bishop move that attacks the king.
steps.after: The bishop is safe, and Black must answer the check first.

steps.text: So before every move, ask three things: what the last move attacks, what you can capture, and what has no guard.

summary: Before every move, look for checks, captures and threats, and for any piece of yours or theirs left unguarded.
